payload.rationale: Hard-gate failures require edits in locked/unsafe sections that this role is not allowed to change: (1) /plan_package/architecture/options/*/risks must be removed or converted to valid in-register risk IDs to satisfy id_integrity; (2) /plan_package/risk_register/7 (K8) needs mitigation/acceptance populated to satisfy risk_closure; (3) /plan_package/acceptance_tests/2 (AT3) procedure/pass_criteria need adjustment to remove dependency on exclusion config, but this role is prohibited from editing /acceptance_tests. Additionally, decision_log evidence pointers referencing missing entity_id B1 can be fixed here, but doing only that would not clear the hard gates. Reroute is required to a role permitted to edit architecture/options, risk_register, and acceptance_tests.
